items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Joseph King Oliver was born in 1885 on Dryde Street in New Orleans.

ctx.x: That's much later. Joseph King Oliver was born in 1885 on Dryde Street in New Orleans. I guess you saw that in the books. Yeah. Well, I copied a lot of things that I read out of the books in here. The notation. I thought maybe I'd read some of these. Did you ever read Charles Delaney's book?
